mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ff_audit_log (project_id, environment_id, flag_id, operator_name, operation, before_json, after_json, created_at) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{environmentId}, #{flagId}, #{operatorName}, #{operation}, #{beforeJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{afterJson}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, environment_id, flag_id, operator_name, operation, before_json, after_json, created_at FROM ff_audit_log WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
